reviews.title: Ruined a great app
reviews.text:
Let me preface, I am a hunter who has used this app for 8+ years here’s a couple of issues.

1. The map box update from google maps doesn’t work offline because some blocking api call and access to an area menu doesn’t allow me to access the offline maps option for a region unless I have signal. Which defeats offline maps purpose.

2. The map is glitchy I am constantly stuck on screens and selecting map layers. I’m currently stuck on tree cover and can’t get off no
Matter what option I select.

3. The old app version had better caching now it’s constantly trying to reload instead of just keeping in local memory or on the device the current session. So back to point 1 if you have signal then lose it then open the app. Nothing. 

4. The wind data has gotten terrible on the weather it will say SW wind only to on the Map show a NE wind opposite of apple and even what the apps weather shows.

5. My single most annoying bug is the fact y’all use my current location instead of the middle of the area GPS waypoint I have setup when I made the area like the app used to do. As someone who has multiple hunting areas in multiple states this with the locked out zoom level is sooo annoying. Sitting in florida having to scroll to North Dakota to find my area to plan a hunt…it’s untenable. 

Rant over please make it better.

reviews.title: Good but very buggy
reviews.text: I have used HuntStand for several years. I have overall enjoyed the app but be warned: it is very buggy. I am very tech savvy and know my way around interfaces. This year (2025), the wind app didn’t work at all…the entire season, which was annoying. If you Google this, it is a well-known problem. The line tool never was accurate this year. I had to reset the app frequently. I wrote to customer service twice complaining about issues. They responded to initial email acknowledging issues but the issues persisted. I haven’t heard back from my second email. I have downloaded OnX and will decide whether or not to keep HuntStand but bottom line: it was good but has gone down hill FAST.

Buyer Beware!!!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️ (3-Star Review 

I’ve been a loyal HuntStand user for several years and relied on this app heavily during hunting season. Unfortunately, over the past year the experience has gone downhill enough that I ultimately canceled my paid subscription.

After turning off auto-renew, I immediately lost access to features I had already paid for, even though my subscription period had not expired. That should never happen — access should remain active through the full term that was purchased.

Previously, when I upgraded my plan, HuntStand’s system failed to properly merge the subscriptions and instead left two active plans, resulting in duplicate billing. This wasn’t caught automatically and required customer service involvement.

Beyond billing and account issues, the app itself has become increasingly profit-driven. Features that longtime users relied on are now paywalled, and frequent updates have introduced instability. I personally experienced loss of saved boundaries and data, which is a serious problem when you’re managing hunting property and relying on accurate maps in the field.

What finally pushed me to cancel was customer support. I submitted a detailed complaint and did not receive a response for two months — long after the issue mattered.

HuntStand still has one of the best concepts and map layers available, which is why this is disappointing. With better account management, data stability, and timely support, this app could be great again. Right now, it’s not li

reviews.title: Completely unreliable during hunting season
reviews.text: I've been using Hunterstand for years and for the most part have liked it, but I've noticed every year during hunting season. This year it started switching map areas on you frequently so that you're in a completely different managed area that you saved. Originally we chose this over some of the competitors because you could see the location of your friends however it really doesn't work and you have to leave the main area in order to use that feature. It says that hunters use this, but it really doesn't act like it. Simple things like not being able to choose the default color for different icons. If I mark a scrape, rub, stands, etc, I want it to set the default color. Right now I have to manually change the color when I add. I download areas so that when I hit areas without cell phone service, I'll have the maps, however that does not seem to work most of the time. It looks like I'll be changing to a different platform this coming year because hunt stand has proven itself to be consistently unreliable.
